candidates.snippet: Last week Ukraine's defense forces destroyed two Russian bombers worth around $100 million, Ukraine's MoD reports. They also hit the Energiya plant, which makes batteries for guided bombs, and an Iskander-M launcher in Kursk region. https://t.co/W3YYqyxPej

Tochnyi's animated infographic shows Russian attacks killed 50 Ukrainian civilians and wounded 351 between October 25 and 29. Kharkiv region had the most casualties at 84, nine of them killed. Dnipropetrovsk region had 66 casualties but the most deaths, 19.
